intro.title: Launch Is Just the Beginning
paragraphs: Software is never really finished. Operating systems and browsers update, third-party APIs change, security vulnerabilities are discovered, users report bugs and your business needs new features. Without regular maintenance, even well-built software slowly becomes slow, insecure and expensive to fix.

Our application maintenance and support services keep your software healthy after launch. We monitor uptime and performance, fix bugs quickly, apply security patches and dependency updates, adapt the software to new platforms and keep improving it with small enhancements. Every request is logged in a support ticketing system with agreed response times, so nothing falls through the cracks.

We maintain software we built and software built by other teams. After a short code audit and knowledge transfer, we take responsibility for your websites, web apps, mobile apps, ERP, CRM or SaaS platforms. Need bigger changes? See our <sd>software development services</sd> or <contact>tell us about your system</contact>.

faqs.title: Software Maintenance & Support FAQs
faqs.subtitle: Quick answers about keeping your software healthy after launch.

items.q: What are software maintenance and support services?
items.a: They are ongoing services that keep software working well after launch: fixing bugs, applying security patches and updates, monitoring uptime and performance, adapting to new platforms and making small improvements, with a support desk for user requests.

items.q: What are the types of software maintenance?
items.a: In software engineering there are four types: corrective maintenance fixes bugs, adaptive maintenance keeps software compatible with new environments, perfective maintenance adds improvements and features, and preventive maintenance reduces future problems through refactoring and updates.

items.q: What is included in an application maintenance and support plan?
items.a: Our plans include bug fixes, security patches, dependency and platform updates, backups, uptime and performance monitoring, a ticketing system with SLAs, monthly reports and a set number of hours for enhancements.

items.q: Can you maintain software built by another company?
items.a: Yes. We start with a code and system audit and a knowledge transfer, document the system, then take over maintenance and support. We regularly take over projects from previous vendors and freelancers.

items.q: What response times do you offer?
items.a: Response times depend on your plan, from next business day on essential plans to within one hour for critical issues on 24/7 enterprise plans. Every request is tracked in our ticketing system.

items.q: Do you offer website and mobile app maintenance?
items.a: Yes. We maintain business and ecommerce websites, web applications and Android and iOS apps, including content updates, OS and browser compatibility, security and performance.

items.q: How much does software maintenance cost?
items.a: Essential maintenance plans typically cost $300 to $800 per month, business support $800 to $2,500 per month, and 24/7 enterprise SLA support from $2,500 per month, depending on your software and needs.
